# Blue Bookmark

> An n8n community node and TypeScript library that checks every email or document for hidden prompt injection before an AI agent reads it. It finds what a person reading the message cannot see: CSS-hidden HTML, invisible and lookalike Unicode, encoded instructions, fake chat structure and attacks split across subject, body and attachments. Score 0–100; 70 and above blocks. No LLM call, offline, no runtime dependencies. On unseen LLMail-Inject attacks that beat every Microsoft defence it blocks 81% (prototype: 41%), with 0 of 73 normal emails blocked.

MIT license. It is the static layer that runs before an LLM guard: it does not judge what plain text means.

## Files

- [packages/core](packages/core/README.md): the scanner library and its API reference
- [packages/n8n-node](packages/n8n-node/README.md): the n8n node and its parameter reference
- [examples/n8n/email-guard.json](examples/n8n/email-guard.json): a ready workflow with two sample emails
- [apps/demo](apps/demo/index.html): a single-file browser demo
